Source: James, Witten, Hastie and Tibshirani (2021), ISLR 2e, section 5.1.2.
-->
:::{#def-loocv}
#### Leave-one-out cross-validation

**Leave-one-out cross-validation (LOOCV)**
is [$k$-fold cross-validation](#def-kfold) with $k = n$,
so that each fold holds one observation.
Writing $\fittedwo{i}{\cdot}$ for the rule fitted
to all observations except observation $i$,
its [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate) (@eq-cv-estimate with $k = n$) is

$$
\cvest{n} = \frac{1}{n} \sumin \sqf{\fittedwo{i}{x_i} - y_i}.
$$ {#eq-loocv}

:::
